mutable_source_policy: Vendor help, product, and pricing pages are mutable and describe only public stated behavior at access. Preserve prior IDs and observations; do not silently rebind or overwrite them. Resolve current product fit, region/currency, plan entitlement, retention, and pricing with a dated written quote and demonstration.
